purpose: Archive exact legacy production Prisma migration files that are already recorded as applied in production but are intentionally outside the active clean-install migration chain.
emptyDatabaseSafety: These SQL files must never execute on an empty database. Use only the production migration overlay after database history guards verify the exact legacy applied rows.
productionHistoryPolicy: _prisma_migrations is evidence and must not be manually edited. prisma migrate resolve must not be used to conceal this divergence.
